name: Matthias
role: Chosen by lot to replace Judas
whenBasis: The first years of the Jerusalem church, between the crucifixion (AD 30 or 33) and Saul's conversion, which Paul's own reckoning (Galatians 1:18; 2:1) and the Gallio date put ≈AD 33–35.
summary: One of the men who had been with the apostles the whole time from John's baptism to the ascension. After Judas's death Peter called for one of them to become a witness of the resurrection. Two were put forward, Joseph called Barsabbas and Matthias; the disciples prayed, cast lots, and the lot fell to Matthias, who was added to the eleven apostles.
body: Peter reads Judas's end in the Psalms: “May another take his position.” Matthias is not named again.

later.text: Eusebius reports that he had been one of the Seventy whom Jesus sent out. Traditions of his mission and death disagree.
